subject: PrivOffer harmonization request — SentryWorks (AWS + GCP) rev-share / payment term ask
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@sentryworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PrivOffer request — harmonized rev-share & payment terms

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — SentryWorks is ready to move forward with a private offer on AWS and GCP. Procurement asked me to send the specific asks so you can route for approvals. High level:

- Request: Private offer covering both AWS and GCP marketplace listings (single offer if possible)
- Rev-share: 35% on usage attributed to marketplace purchases (we know this is above standard; customer insists for go-to-market economics)
- Payment terms: Net 90 preferred (they have a single billing cycle requirement across vendors)
- Commit: 12-month expected minimum revenue target ($420k ARR)

We've attached a short business case. Can you confirm whether Redwood can do a blended rev-share and how quickly legal/finance can sign off? Procurement is on a tight timeline (they want DOC returned before May 10).

Thanks — look forward to a path to close.

Elena Torres
Head of Strategic Alliances, SentryWorks
Elena.Torres@sentryworks.com

Attachments: SentryWorks_BusinessCase.pdf (PDF)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrivOffer request — harmonized rev-share & payment terms

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. I'm looping in Deal Desk and Sales Ops to scope feasibility. Quick clarifying Qs to help expedite:

1) When you say a single offer, do you need identical rev-share and payment terms applied across both marketplaces, or is a blended effective rev-share acceptable?
2) Any regulatory or Geo restrictions on the committed revenue (US only or multi-geo)?

We'll aim to get an internal recommendation within 48 hours. If it helps, please also share the procurement contact and any standard PO language.

I copied the internal team.

— Rishi

Subject: Fwd: PrivOffer request — SentryWorks — need approval recommendation

Team — forwarding SentryWorks' asks. Short summary and my quick read:

- They requested 35% rev-share across AWS + GCP and net90 payment terms; 12-month minimum commit.
- Our standard marketplace rev-share cap is typically 20–25% for private offers (varies by cloud). Net90 is above typical terms and exposes cashflow risk.

Proposal (recommendation for approval path):
- Counter: Blended rev-share 32% (weighted: AWS 30% / GCP 34%) to stay closer to platform limits, but still above standard.
- Payment terms: Net60 (mitigates cashflow exposure).
- Commit: Require signed 12-month commitment with milestone-based payouts and minimum quarterly invoice guarantee.
- Offsets: Ask for $40k marketing co-fund or co-selling commitment to justify higher rev-share.

I attached a quick calc showing unit economics and impact to FY27 revenue. If we want to move higher on rev-share or Net90, we will need exec signoff (Marissa/Lauren). Please weigh legal/program constraints (Karthik) and pricing impact (Marissa).

Attachments: RDW_revshare_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Rishi
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: PrivOffer request — SentryWorks — need approval recommendation

Rishi / team,

Quick legal and program notes:
- AWS Marketplace policy: engineered max private-offer rev-share without partner uplift is 30% in most cases; exceptions require marketplace PM approval and a compliance review.
- GCP: can support up to ~34% in special cases but Finance requires stronger credit terms or a reseller guarantee.
- Net90: we can do Net60 standardly; Net90 will require an AR risk assessment and Treasury sign-off (timeline ~5 business days).

If the sales side can accept a blended 32% with Net60 and a $40k marketing co-fund + 12-month committed revenue, legal will draft the amendment and Finance will prioritize the AR paperwork. Otherwise we need exec signoff for larger deviations.

— Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: SentryWorks — ask to approve blended 32% rev-share + Net60

Lauren — looping you for executive approval. We have a high-propensity close opportunity with SentryWorks (vertical: security monitoring, strong platform fit). Customer insists 35% and Net90; Deal Desk/Legal recommend blended 32% + Net60 + $40k marketing fund to justify concession.

Business case highlights:
- ARR potential: $420k committed over 12 months; immediate TCV ~ $500k including professional services.
- Strategic: references and joint GTM could accelerate category adoption in our target segment.
- Risk: cashflow exposure with Net90; mitigation via payment milestones and marketing offset.

Requested ask to you: Approve one-time deviation to allow blended 32% rev-share and Net60 payment, conditioned on:
1) Signed 12-month commitment with quarterly minimums;
2) $40k marketing co-fund or co-selling plan in writing;
3) Legal to finalize amendment and DocuSign before May 11.

If approved, we'll hand this off to Legal for amendment and Finance for AR setup. We need a decision today to meet procurement timeline.

— Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: SentryWorks — ask to approve blended 32% rev-share + Net60

Approved with conditions.

Decision: Approve blended rev-share up to 32% (AWS 30% / GCP 34% weighted blended = 32%) and Net60 payment terms for SentryWorks, contingent on the following being completed before signature:
1) SentryWorks signs the 12-month commitment with quarterly minimums and milestone-triggered invoices;
2) Marketing co-fund: $40,000 confirmed in writing (email or SOW line item) or equivalent co-selling credit;
3) Legal to include a fall-back to standard rev-share (25%) if usage falls below 30% of committed ARR in any two consecutive quarters;
4) Finance/Treasury completes AR risk intake and approves Net60 (no Net90).

Once the amendment language is drafted, send me the DocuSign link and a one-paragraph memo summarizing the approved deviations and the rationale. If all conditions are met, I will sign.

— Lauren Bishop
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
